title.rendered: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NITC) Applications from eligible candidates for the following Post of Research Associate Job Vacancy 2026

content.rendered:
Applications are invited from interested and eligible candidates for the following Positions. Interested Eligible candidates fulfilling the criteria may submit their applications in the prescribed format along with the detailed CV / As per the Norms.

🏢 NAME OF THE INSTITUTION

NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY CALICUT

🏫 ABOUT INSTITUTION

ABOUT-TEXT-WRITTEN-BY-FACULTYTICK premier technical institution located in Kerala.

💼 DESIGNATION / JOB POSITION

  • Research Associate-I

🎯 Project Details

  • Name of Project -“Identification of Avenues for harnessing Administrative Data / Triangulation of Various New Data Sources viz. E-commerce Sales Data, etc. with Conventional Data Sources for Developing Price Indices“
  • Name of the sponsoring Agency – MoSPI
  • Duration of Engagement – Initially for 3 months for Contract basis, may be extendable up to nine months based on the performance & availability of fund.

🎓 QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE / REQUIREMENT

Essential qualifications include a PhD or a Master’s degree in Engineering/Technology or MSc in Computer Science/Information Technology/Data Science and Artificial Intelligence/Electronics and Communication Engineering/Electrical Engineering with 3 years of experience and at least one journal publication.

The details of the required qualifications & experience along with other relevant information are available on the Institute Website.

🏆 SALARY / REMUNERATION / PAY SCALE ₹

Rs. 65,000 /- 

💺 JOB LOCATION

NIT Campus [P.O], Kerala-673601, India

📝 HOW TO APPLY

Candidates have to fill the registration form provided and submit the duly filled form along with the most recent CV, soft copies of the mark sheet/certificates supporting their academic qualifications/experience. All the soft copies should be consolidated into a single PDF document and emailed to rescsed@nitc.ac.in with a copy to chandramanic@nitc.ac.in the specified email address, using the subject line “Application for Research Associate In MoSPI Project”.

Interested and eligible candidates are invited to submit their applications, including an updated Curriculum Vitae, copies of relevant certificates, and a passport-sized photograph, to the specified email address.

📅 IMPORTANT DATE

The last date for receiving applications is On or Before 13th November 2026

title.rendered: University of Allahabad Applications are invited from the interested candidates for the position of Postdoctoral Fellowship Job Vacancy 2026

content.rendered:
INTRO-TEXT-WRITTEN-BY-FACULTYTICK prestigious Postdoctoral Fellowship.

University of Allahabad Postdoctoral Fellowship Opportunity

OVERVIEW-TEXT-WRITTEN-BY-FACULTYTICK unique opportunity.

Position

Postdoctoral Fellowship (PDF) 

Eligibility and Research Domain

 Ph.D. degree with the research domain focusing in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) or Information Technology/IT Enabled Services (IT/ ITES)


Fellowship Amount – ₹1,08,393/month

Department – Electronics and Communication, University of Allahabad

Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants must be Indian citizens with a Ph.D. degree from a recognized institution, completed within the last five years.
  • A first-class academic record is required at all preceding levels of education.
  • The upper age limit is 40 years at the time of application submission.

Application Process

Interested candidates must submit a duly completed application form, a comprehensive CV, a research proposal, and self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents. Applications should be sent by Indian post to the Head of the Department, Department of Electronics and Communication, Science Faculty, University of Allahabad, Prayagraj-211002, U.P. India. Additionally, candidates must email the completed application form and supporting documents to nodal_visphd@allduniv.ac.in.

Selection Process

  • Stage I: Screening test conducted offline at the University of Allahabad campus.
  • Stage II: Personal interview conducted by a panel of experts, potentially on the same or the next day of the screening test.

Important Dates and Contact Information

The last date for receiving applications is 18th November 2026. For further details, candidates are advised to visit the official website of the University of Allahabad at www.allduniv.ac.in.

📧 EMAIL

nodal_visphd@allduniv.ac.in

Address

University of Allahabad, Prayagraj-211002, U.P.
